text:
Tether dropped by 15,000 tomans

Alongside the rise in global oil prices and the fall in global gold prices following the intensification of unrest in the Strait of Hormuz, the price of Tether also declined by 15,000 tomans, from 189,000 tomans to 174,000 tomans.
translated_text:
Tether 减少了 15,000 个 tomans

随着霍尔木兹海峡骚乱加剧导致全球油价上涨和全球金价下跌，Tether 价格也下跌了 15,000 托曼，从 189,000 托曼跌至 174,000 托曼。
